Title: CL-STA-1238 Cairn - ipv4
Description: Hong Kong server that hosted the attackers' customised Cairn autonomous attack framework and its controller login page. Source: Unit 42 – Attackers Use Autonomous AI to Target Semiconductor, Defense and Civil Society Sectors https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cairn-framework-ai-autonomous-attacks/
RecommendedActions: Block at the perimeter and search 90 days of proxy, DNS and firewall logs for connections.
